rows.vgi.doc_md:
## Demo tower pairs

Two synthetic pairs in EPSG:32618 for demo://ridge.tif: high has an 80 m tower and low has a 2 m tower. Both receivers are 2 m above ground. No network or credentials are needed.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Inspect the two tower heights", "sql": "SELECT pair_id, source_height_m FROM terrain.main.demo_input ORDER BY pair_id"}]
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description": "Demo tower pairs on bundled synthetic data", "sql": "SELECT pair_id, source_height_m FROM terrain.main.demo_input ORDER BY pair_id", "expected_result": [["high", 80.0], ["low", 2.0]]}]
